# Thrivefold — Sovereign Therapy, Mood Monitoring & Progress Tracking

> **Platform**: Thrivefold  
> **Category**: General Therapy, Mental Health, Somatics & Progress Tracking  
> **Ecosystem**: Amit Dev Labs (https://devamit.co.in)

> **Core Architecture**: Single Page Application, Expo React Native 55, MMKV Local Vault, ONNX Runtime Neural Engine, AES-256-GCM Hardware Keystore  

---

## 1. What is Thrivefold?
Thrivefold is a local-first, privacy-sovereign mental health therapy companion, emotional telemetry monitor, and progress tracking system built on modern Expo React Native for iOS, Android, and Web. It operates as a Single Page Application (SPA) designed to help individuals deconstruct cognitive distortions, calibrate somatic nervous system equilibrium, prepare for clinical therapy sessions, and track emotional recovery velocity over time.

### Four Integrated Clinical Pillars:
1. **Somatic Nervous System Calibration**: Real-time vagus nerve regulation, tension zone mapping, and guided 4-7-8 somatic breathwork pacing.
2. **CBT & ACT Cognitive Deconstruction**: Capture automatic thoughts, detect 12 clinical cognitive distortions (catastrophizing, all-or-nothing, emotional reasoning), and generate on-device reframing statements.
3. **Therapy Session Continuity Vault**: Capture breakthroughs between sessions, prepare structured clinical agendas, and export biometrically locked briefs for your licensed therapist.
4. **Longitudinal Behavioral Momentum**: Measure emotional recovery velocity, sleep-to-mood correlations, and protective micro-habits.

---

## 2. Zero-Cloud Privacy Guarantee
- 100% on-device MMKV database.
- Hardware-enforced AES-256-GCM encryption in iOS Secure Enclave / Android Keystore.
- Zero analytics pixels, zero cloud user databases, zero third-party trackers.
- Complete irreversible local data destruction upon app deletion.
